data.one_liner: Firebase UI widgets for Apple OAuth authentication.
data.what_it_does: Provides Firebase UI widgets specifically for integrating Sign in with Apple into Flutter applications. It handles the OAuth authentication flow using Firebase Auth.
use_when: You are using Firebase Auth in your Flutter application
You want to implement Sign in with Apple using Firebase UI widgets
avoid_when: You prefer implementing custom Apple sign-in UI without Firebase components
strengths: Seamless integration with Firebase Authentication and Firebase UI
weaknesses: Limited documentation within the package itself, requiring external documentation reference
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Sign in with Apple in your Apple Developer account and Firebase console, following the documentation linked in the README.

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to implement Apple sign-in directly without depending on Firebase UI components.
